name: Sparkplug
look: A short scrappy boxer robot with mismatched battery-pack gloves and a cracked face screen, bouncing on its toes.
quip: Cracked face, mismatched gloves, still bouncing.

name: Mutt
look: A scruffy stray robo-dog standing on its hind legs, big goofy face, bent ear antenna, chewed rubber collar, one pink LED tooth, tongue out.
quip: Chewed his own collar. Has opinions about yours.

name: Stubby
look: A tiny squat robot with a big determined face and two stumpy legs, straining to hold an oversized orange cannon over its head.
quip: Can barely lift the cannon. Never misses the point.

name: Rookie
look: A gangly nervous rookie swordsman robot with a face screen showing wide anxious eyes, a dented practice helmet too big for it, gripping a bent metal-ruler sword with both shaky hands, knees knocking.
quip: Sword's a ruler. Helmet's a bucket. Still brave.

name: Pinch
look: A small wind-up toy scorpion robot with a cheeky grinning face, wind-up key in its back, green bulb on its tail.
quip: Wound up every morning. Cannot stop grinning about it.

name: Peeper
look: A small nervous hall-monitor security-guard robot on two short legs, round body, one oversized red camera-lens eye, a guard cap too big for it, clutching a tiny flashlight, worried face.
quip: Saw something. Said something. Now regrets everything.

name: Typo
look: A thin nerdy hacker bot hunched over a cracked old laptop strapped to its chest, pink glasses.
quip: Hacks like he types: fast, loud, and full of mistakes.

name: Twig
look: A spindly stick-insect robot made of coat hangers with a nervous little face and big eyes, tiny teal claws raised, wobbling on a branch.
quip: Made of coat hangers and nerves. Hard to hang up on.

name: Boxy
look: A little cardboard-box robot CHARACTER with a face (two bottle-cap eyes, a determined frown), stubby arms balancing a toilet-roll tube cannon on its shoulder, tank-tread feet, yellow hazard tape.
quip: Arrived in a box. Fights from inside one. No returns.

name: Tangle
look: A scrapyard robot hopelessly wrapped in its own cables, one spark at the end of a loose wire.
quip: Tripped over himself twice just introducing himself.

name: Crumbs
look: A scrappy pigeon courier robot standing upright like a person, little mail satchel, cracked goggles pushed up, holding a crumpled envelope, cocky grin, one bent amber wing.
quip: Special delivery. Return to sender is not an option.

name: Lugnut
look: A stocky worn-out dock-worker robot in a dented hard hat with a blue warning light, big flat fork-shaped hands, hugging a small crate, mid-yawn.
quip: Clocked in tired. Will clock you out.

name: Peekaboo
look: A shy little robot half-hiding under a ragged violet tarp, only its eyes glowing.
quip: Hides under a tarp. The eyes give him away.

name: Zippy
look: A tiny jittery ferret robot in a racing scarf, amber eye lights, a spring for a tail, mid-twitch.
quip: Three espressos deep and the spring tail knows it.

name: Grumbles
look: A grumpy old groundskeeper robot with a lawnmower for a lower body, a bushy grass-clipping moustache, lime grass stains, leaning on a rake.
quip: Get off his lawn. And his arena. And his planet.

name: Crispin
look: A stocky robot whose head is an old toaster with a grumpy face on the front, orange glow inside the slots, oven-mitt fists raised.
quip: Always angry, always warm, always slightly burnt.

name: Brrbert
look: A chubby little fish robot waddling on two stubby legs in a fishbowl helmet, ice-pop stick horn, frosty pale blue, curious face.
quip: Fish in a bowl, horn from a popsicle. Cool under pressure.

name: Slurp
look: A sneaky little rubbery robot with suction-cup hands, slurping juice from a battery through a magenta straw, guilty grin.
quip: Caught red-handed. Not even a little sorry.

name: Drifter Joe
look: An old weathered wandering robot in a torn straw hat, one red neon pocketknife.
quip: Old hat, older knife. Mostly just wants a nap.

name: Noodle
look: A lazy garden-hose snake robot with a sleepy face on its green nozzle head, wearing a tiny sunhat, coiled up.
quip: Coils up for a nap mid-fight. Sunhat stays on.

name: Plodder
look: A huge lumbering but sleepy robot that walks with a cane, red standby light, rust patches.
quip: Takes forever to arrive. Takes longer to leave.

name: Lag
look: A small pixelated robot that looks half-rendered, one pink block flickering out of place.
quip: Hit him. Wait three seconds. Now he's hit you.

name: Bumper
look: A chunky little rhino robot standing upright in bumper-car padding, rubber traffic-cone horn, yellow paint, eager grin.
quip: Built for bumper cars. Drives everything else the same way.

name: Buzzby
look: A tiny round drone robot with a big curious face on its body, four little propeller arms, a duct-tape bandage, waving.
quip: Held together by duct tape and sheer enthusiasm.

name: Clicks
look: A small safe-cracker robot with a dial-lock for a face and a stethoscope, cyan readout.
quip: Hears every secret. Tells none of them.

name: Skitter
look: A shy spider robot whose head is an old webcam (the lens is its one big eye), eight wire legs, violet recording light, waving one leg.
quip: Always recording, never talking. Waves awkwardly.

name: Wobbles
look: A wobbly little robot kid wearing a teal paper-pinwheel propeller beanie, arms out trying to fly, determined face.
quip: Believes he can fly. Gravity has notes.

name: Tumbleweed
look: A dusty cowboy robot with a too-big hat and a bottle-cap sheriff badge, amber eyes.
quip: Hat's too big, badge is a bottle cap, aim is surprisingly fine.

name: Chomps
look: An inflatable pool-toy shark robot standing upright on little flippers, blue fin, leak patch, goofy toothy grin, holding a swim ring.
quip: Slow leak, big smile. Please do not pop.

name: Steamy
look: A stout grumpy teakettle robot with a face, stubby arms on its hips, orange glowing belly, steam puffing from its whistle head like it is annoyed.
quip: Whistles when annoyed, which is always.

name: Prickles
look: A short grumpy cactus-shaped robot covered in blunt rubber spikes, lime green.
quip: Rubber spikes. Zero danger. Maximum attitude.

name: Chunk
look: A big lazy gorilla bot sitting down, eating a battery like a banana, pale blue knuckle lights.
quip: Mid-snack. Do not interrupt.

name: Digger
look: A small mole bot with a hand-crank drill nose and a miner lamp, dirt on its face.
quip: Always pops up in the wrong place. Blames the map.

name: Thump
look: A robot whose torso is a beat-up boombox, teal speaker cones, headphones round its neck.
quip: Bass up, volume up, patience out.

name: Scraps
look: A scruffy black stray cat robot in a torn bandana, one violet eye, notched ear, smug grin, sitting on a trash bin with its arms crossed.
quip: Lives on a bin. Rules the alley. Disrespects your furniture.

name: Pops
look: A tiny trigger-happy robot with a cork-gun barrel strapped to its back, an oversized army helmet, amber bulb, excited face.
quip: Cork gun, big helmet, bigger ego.

name: Overtime
look: A tired office-worker robot in a loose tie, bags under its eyes, clutching a huge coffee mug in one hand and a clunky wrench in the other.
quip: Running on caffeine and spite. Mostly spite.

name: Soggy
look: A small swamp gator robot whose body is an old rubber boot, the stitched lime teeth on the toe form its grin, little legs, mischievous eyes.
quip: A boot with a smile and a bad attitude. Smells like swamp.

name: Huddle
look: A small timid robot peeking out from behind a big blue umbrella it holds as a shield, nervous eyes.
quip: Behind the umbrella, nobody can see him. He thinks.

name: Doodle
look: A cheeky little graffiti robot with spray-can hands and a magenta paint smear on its face.
quip: Tagged your shoes, your car, and your dignity.

name: Bumbles
look: A fat fuzzy bumblebee robot in tiny aviator goggles, tiny wings, a dim yellow bulb stinger, proud face.
quip: Tiny wings, big ego, dim stinger. Flies anyway.

name: Clingy
look: A small horseshoe-magnet robot with a face, little arms and legs, red belly, paperclips and bottle caps stuck all over it, embarrassed.
quip: Attracts paperclips, bottle caps, and awkward moments.

name: Fritz
look: A sheet-over-the-head ghost robot made of a pale blue bedsheet with a TV-static face.
quip: Not a ghost. Just a sheet. With a lot of static.

name: Squeak
look: A small round bat robot with big ears made from satellite dishes, tiny headphones, pink sonar dot, curious face.
quip: Hears everything, including your embarrassing mumble.

name: Slice
look: A cocky pizza-delivery robot with a pizza-cutter wheel for one hand, lime cap, tomato stain, holding a pizza box.
quip: Delivers hot pizza and cold stares. Tip him.

name: Bouncer
look: A big blocky doorman robot with a velvet rope and arms crossed, orange name tag.
quip: Your name's not on the list. Neither is your lunch.

name: Truffle
look: A round piglet robot with tiny red tusks and a detective magnifier on a string, sniffing the ground.
quip: Sniffs out clues. Mostly finds snacks.

name: Fizzbang
look: A little robot strapped to two soda-bottle rockets, pink fuse sparkling.
quip: Powered by soda. Landing plan pending.

name: Scrounge
look: A tiny scavenger robot with two butter knives, wearing a bottle cap as a helmet.
quip: Two butter knives, zero table manners.

name: Squishy
look: A small rubber octopus robot in a tiny sailor hat, teal suckers, wobbly happy face.
quip: Wears the sailor hat to look tough. Fails adorably.

name: Patch
look: A small repair robot with welding goggles pushed up, cyan torch tip, covered in sticky bandages.
quip: More bandages than robot. Does not slow down.

name: Raver
look: A skinny robot made of bent pink glowsticks with a goofy face, slightly flickering, striking a dance pose.
quip: Flickers on the beat and sometimes off it.

name: Giggles
look: A scruffy laughing hyena bot with a cracked amber visor and a cheap squeaky voice box.
quip: Laughs through a squeaky box. Still somehow intimidating.

name: Honeypot
look: A little beekeeper robot in a veil hat holding a taped-up jar of tiny yellow drone bees, a few escaping, worried face.
quip: The tape on the jar is holding. Mostly.

name: Fuzz
look: A puffball robot with hair standing up from static, cyan sparks crackling off one tip.
quip: Wears a perm powered by rubbing socks.

name: Stitches
look: A big soft plush teddy-bear robot with an orange exhaust pipe on its back, a stitched smile.
quip: Soft, huggable, and leaking exhaust. Don't ask.

name: Grabby
look: An arcade claw-machine robot with a happy face on its glass front, a long amber claw arm proudly holding up a prize, little wheels.
quip: Always wins prizes. Never gives them back.

name: Twitchy
look: A tall thin robot with a red match head, a tiny flame on top, nervous expression.
quip: Strikes first because he's scared of everything else.

name: Sticky
look: A small sticky-footed gecko robot in tiny climbing goggles, grinning, climbing a wall, lime green, one static spark.
quip: Climbs walls, sticks to everything, regrets nothing.

name: Lanky
look: A tall skinny sleepy night-watchman robot with a buzzing pale blue streetlight bulb for a head, dented pole body, little cap, leaning on a stick.
quip: Falls asleep on shift. The light stays on.

name: Mangy
look: A thin scheming street-dog robot standing upright in a torn leather vest, sly grin, amber collar light, rubbing its hands together.
quip: Runs a gang of one and calls it a syndicate.

name: Dusty
look: A fluffy little moth robot standing upright hugging a bare light bulb like a teddy, pale blue wings, dusty, dreamy face.
quip: Won't let go of the bulb. Or grudges.

name: Scoops
look: A toddler-sized bulldozer robot with a face, pushing an orange plastic blade of sand like a kid playing, proud grin.
quip: Moves mountains. Well, sandcastles.

name: Tally
look: A calm little robot sitting cross-legged, counting on teal abacus beads around its neck.
quip: Counts to ten before hitting. Then counts your mistakes.

name: Socks
look: A small fox bot with two pink-tipped tails and odd socks on its feet.
quip: Two tails, four feet, zero matching socks.

name: Sweaty
look: A frantic box-fan robot with a face, arms and legs, its blades spinning too fast, red-hot grille, sweat drops flying.
quip: Runs hot, runs fast, runs out of excuses.

name: Clatter
look: A scrappy little street-kid robot banging a blue trash-can lid like a gong with a stick, defiant grin.
quip: Makes noise first, plans second.

name: Scuttle
look: A round beetle robot standing upright on little legs, teal oil-slick shell, wobbly antennae, a brave face, holding a bottle-cap shield.
quip: Bottle-cap shield, wobbly antennae. Be gentle.

name: Boing
look: A robot bouncing on a violet pogo stick it uses as a lance.
quip: Jousts on a pogo stick. Has never once stuck the landing.

name: Twirl
look: A small dancer robot in a tutu made of pink pipe cleaners, on one toe.
quip: Pirouettes into your shin, then curtsies.

name: Tapeye
look: A scruffy little crow detective in a tiny trench coat, one cheap camera lens taped over an eye, tilting its head.
quip: Case closed. The case was a shiny button.

name: Strawshot
look: A small robot with a long drinking-straw sniper barrel, pale blue scope.
quip: Aims through a straw. Hits through a straw.

name: Squirt
look: A cocky little robot holding a big red water pistol, dripping.
quip: Brought a water pistol to a gunfight. Is winning anyway.

name: Springy
look: A tiny bunny robot with spring legs and a sweatband, mid-bounce, cyan ear lights, determined face.
quip: Bounces back from everything, mostly off walls.

name: Munch
look: A grumpy office paper-shredder robot with a face, little arms and legs, green teeth, paper stuck in its mouth, holding a stapler.
quip: Eats paperwork, spits confetti, staples the rest.

name: Rollo
look: A robot on old roller skates with a bike-chain belt, orange knee pads.
quip: Brakes are a suggestion. Knee pads are a lifestyle.

name: Zappy
look: A wiggly eel robot made of jumper cables with a goofy face on its cyan clamp head, sparking a little.
quip: Half jumper cable, half bad idea, fully shocking.

name: Plugsy
look: A walking power-strip robot with a face, socket-hole eyes, little legs, cables trailing like a tail, cyan lights.
quip: Overloaded socket, overloaded personality.

name: Toots
look: A small robot with a kazoo for a mouth and pale blue sound rings.
quip: Kazoo for a mouth. Zero talent, maximum volume.

name: Fuzzball
look: A round woolly sheep robot in a knitted scarf, curly orange horns made of springs, stubborn face.
quip: Wool sweater, spring horns, one idea: forward.

name: Rattles
look: A small shaky robot riding a jackhammer, amber dust cloud.
quip: Teeth rattle, knees rattle. All of him rattles.

name: Whistles
look: A strict little gym-coach robot with a whistle in its mouth, a blue sweatband and a clipboard, pointing sternly.
quip: Fifty laps. Nobody asked. Nobody argued.

name: Nibbles
look: A tiny robot wearing a goldfish bowl as a helmet with three red robo-piranhas nibbling inside, panicked face.
quip: Wears the bowl so the fish can't get out. The fish disagree.

name: Breezy
look: A cute little desk-fan robot with a happy face in the middle of its teal blades, little arms and feet, a wind swirl.
quip: Oscillates between cheerful and slightly more cheerful.

name: Hustle
look: A small robot running in a yellow hamster wheel that powers its lights.
quip: Runs all day, goes nowhere, lights up the room.

name: Snowball
look: A round fluffy baby mammoth bot with short pale blue ice-pop tusks.
quip: Tusks are ice pops. Do not lick. Do not provoke.

name: Whirr
look: A hyper kitchen-blender robot with a face on its jar, little arms, red blades whirring inside its head.
quip: Blends fruit, ice and enemies. Smoothie of regret.

name: Sly
look: A small sneaky robot in a hoodie, violet smoke puff behind it, holding a stolen bolt.
quip: Stole one bolt. Plans to steal the rest.

name: Tuffy
look: A tiny kitten robot in a too-big spiked collar, comically oversized amber fangs, trying to look tough.
quip: Teeth too big, collar too big, courage just right.

name: Scrubs
look: A round floor-cleaning robot with a busy little face, six little legs, climbing a wall, violet light.
quip: Cleans floors, climbs walls, judges your shoes.

name: Kuro
look: A young martial-artist robot in a clean black gi with blue trim, steady stance.
quip: Black belt, blue trim, zero drama. Bows before and after.

name: Glint
look: A shiny chrome snake robot with cyan eyes, calmly coiled, a little smug.
quip: Polishes himself daily. Reflects badly on everyone else.

name: Brask
look: A squad-leader robot with a radio headset and a glowing tablet, pointing.
quip: Leads from the back. The back has excellent Wi-Fi.

name: Akane
look: A samurai-trainee android in simple red armour, hardlight naginata held at rest.
quip: Still in training. The naginata has not been told.

name: Trio
look: A dog-sized three-headed robo-hound, each head a different neon colour and mood.
quip: Three heads, three moods, one leash nobody can hold.

name: Bastian
look: A sturdy security robot with a solid blue shield, calm and dependable.
quip: Shift ends when you leave. Politely, but it ends.

name: Phase
look: A spy robot in a neat grey suit with a slight static flicker on one side, sly look.
quip: Flickers when lying. Hasn't stopped flickering.

name: Jade
look: A dog-sized young cyber-dragon with small wings and a faint green glow in its throat.
quip: Tiny wings, huge ego. The breath is mostly a rumour.

name: Aria
look: A pink scout drone robot with small swept wings, hovering, alert.
quip: Scouts ahead, reports back, judges your footwork.

name: Revv
look: A racer robot in a clean orange suit and helmet, leaning forward, eager.
quip: Always leaning forward. Even at funerals.

name: Rasha
look: A lean robo-lion cub with a curled amber scorpion tail, confident.
quip: A cub with a stinger. Mostly aimed.

name: Gamma
look: A robot in a clean hazard suit with a glowing lime power-core chest.
quip: Lime glow means fine. Probably. Stand back anyway.

name: Spectra
look: A crystal-faced android holding a small rainbow light blade.
quip: Cuts in seven colours. Bleeds in one.

name: Brontes
look: A sturdy armoured robo-bison calf with a small blue spark between its horns.
quip: Small spark, big plans. Mostly just charges in.

name: Cinder
look: A compact flamethrower robot with a small orange fuel tank on its back, pilot-light flame.
quip: Pilot light's always on. So is his questionable judgment.

name: Auric
look: A golden android with a glowing sun-core in its chest, fists raised.
quip: Sun in his chest, ego to match. Sunscreen sold separately.

name: Tidebreaker
look: A person-sized armoured cyber eel, coiled, its fin blades glowing aqua.
quip: Slippery, armoured, and unbothered by your harbour rules.

name: Ironhull
look: A heavy flying gunboat mech the size of a person, hovering, twin cannons glowing.
quip: A navy of one, airborne. Port and starboard both armed.

name: Hush
look: An assassin android crouched low, its blade glowing with light-eating darkness.
quip: Swings quietly. Light stops being a thing near him.

name: Pyrelle
look: A neon firebird with wings spread, flames running along its feathers.
quip: Dies dramatically. Returns for the applause.

name: Overseer
look: A sleek AI war android with one large all-seeing red lens, arms spread commandingly.
quip: One lens, no blind spots, and your search history on file.

name: Regalis
look: The ruler android of the neon city on a throne above the skyline, hardlight crown, cape flowing.
quip: The crown is hardlight. The ego is solid.

name: Vorgath
look: An ancient chrome alpha predator on a cliff in a lightning storm, eyes burning.
quip: Lightning behind him on the cliff. Staged, obviously.

name: Prime Forge
look: A colossal self-building mech assembling new armour mid-air from swirling parts in a factory of light.
quip: Builds itself mid-fight. The warranty keeps getting longer.

name: Glyphling
look: A young apprentice robot with a clearly visible nervous face under an oversized patched hooded coat, holding a small glowing rune card, one tiny violet glyph floating above it.
quip: Nervous apprentice. The spell works; the hands shake.

name: Flicker
look: A small fluffy fox kit made of soft teal flame, three short tails, sitting and yawning. Gentle glow only.
quip: Yawns flames. Dangerously cozy.

name: Dozy
look: A small plug-in nightlight robot with a soft gold halo ring, sleepy face.
quip: A night light with a nap problem.

name: Scribble
look: A small black robot doodling scarlet symbols on itself with a marker, tongue out.
quip: Draws spells on himself and calls it a tattoo.

name: Dustbunny
look: A tiny grey dust-bunny with a sleepy face, lilac moonlight glow, big floppy ears.
quip: Lives under the couch. Rises at dusk. Judges your cleaning.

name: Crinkle
look: A small crumpled paper-lantern robot with a timid face, little legs, crimson shell, weak candle glow inside.
quip: Afraid of wind, rain and being folded. Glows anyway.

name: Coils
look: A copper slinky-spring robot with a face and little arms, mid-bounce, acid-green spark at one end.
quip: Springs back after every curse. Sproing.

name: Goldie
look: A small goldfish of tangerine flame with big expressive eyes and a proud little grin, swimming in a bubble of air.
quip: One fish, one bubble, infinite swagger.

name: Sprout
look: A tiny seedling robot with a face in a cracked flowerpot, little arms, one pink bud on its head.
quip: Cracked pot, big dreams, one pink bud.

name: Shiver
look: A small robot shaped like an ice lolly with a face and little arms, pale blue, a snowflake sticker on its head, shivering.
quip: Melts if you look at him. Shivers if you don't.

name: Smokey
look: A small scruffy puppy made of grey smoke with ghost-green eyes, a little collar tag, wagging.
quip: Good boy. Slightly see-through.

name: Ding
look: A small doorbell robot with a face, little arms and legs, a silver bell hat, sky-blue ding ring, pressing its own button.
quip: Presses his own button. Nobody's home.

name: Dewey
look: A worm robot poking out of a green paperback book, wearing reading glasses.
quip: Bookworm in the literal sense. Overdue.

name: Hoot
look: A small round owl chick robot in a little sleeping cap, midnight-blue fluff, two big star-dot eyes, yawning.
quip: Up past bedtime. Still won't tell you who.

name: Puddle
look: A small cute water blob spirit sitting in a cracked plastic fountain bowl, calm, one little droplet hovering above its head.
quip: Calm, damp and slightly cracked.

name: Drizzle
look: A small robot under a tiny yellow storm cloud raining on it, grumpy.
quip: Personal rain cloud. Personally offended.

name: Twinkle
look: A wobbly baby deer robot in a little leaf scarf, peach-coral crystal nubs for antlers, shy face.
quip: Wobbly legs, crystal nubs, zero confidence.

name: Owie
look: A small round first-aid box robot with a red cross and plasters stuck all over.
quip: Plasters on everything. Mostly on himself.

name: Dizzy
look: A small robot seeing double, two faint turquoise copies beside it, swirly eyes.
quip: Sees two of you. Hits neither.

name: Puffwyrm
look: A tiny lavender cloud dragon puffing a little mint-green steam ring.
quip: Dragon-shaped cloud. Breathes steam rings, nothing scary.

name: Pebble
look: A small rock robot with a face and stubby arms, one yellow crystal poking out of its head.
quip: Small rock, one shiny secret.

name: Snips
look: A flat robot made of cut-out magenta stencils with a face, one sigil shining through its chest.
quip: Cut out of paper, stenciled to the soul.

name: Shimmy
look: A little butterfly character made of confetti scraps with a happy face, iridescent paper wings.
quip: Confetti wings, party energy, fragile pride.

name: Fluff
look: A fussy butler robot whose head is a feather duster, cobalt body, little bow tie, dusting with a tiny rag.
quip: Dusts you off, then judges the dust.

name: Folds
look: A folded rose-pink paper crane robot standing on thin legs with a little crease face, bowing politely.
quip: Bows politely. Never wrinkles under pressure.

name: Bloop
look: A tiny jellyfish robot with a sleepy face inside a soap bubble, aqua bell, short pink tendrils.
quip: Bubble, jelly, nap. Repeat.

name: Wishes
look: A small striped birthday-candle robot with a face and little arms, calm cyan flame on top, wax drips.
quip: A birthday candle with a head start on regret.

name: Fizz
look: A small potion-bottle robot with a face and little arms, fizzing lime bubbles out of its cork top, giggling.
quip: Bubbling with confidence. Also with something else.

name: Cubby
look: A small bear cub carved from wood with amber painted patterns, a cheerful face, sitting and beating a tiny wooden drum.
quip: Wooden hugs, constant drumming, no exits.

name: Thimble
look: A pin-cushion robot with a kind face, eight needle legs, teal thread trailing, holding a button.
quip: Pinned, stitched and unreasonably nice.

name: Vael
look: A scholarly mage robot in tidy blue robes holding one glowing spellbook.
quip: Read every spell twice. Judges everything.

name: Stormwing
look: A hawk-sized storm bird with violet-white feathers and a small lightning crest.
quip: Every flap files a weather report. Nobody asked for it.

name: Seren
look: A gentle white stone guardian robot carrying a small glowing jade basin.
quip: Calm as stone. Patience, less so.

name: Morrow
look: A spellsword robot in black armour with a rune dagger glowing faint red.
quip: The dagger glows red. Not a mood ring, a warning.

name: Lumi
look: A small aurora-light whale calf drifting playfully, green and pink.
quip: Plays in the sky. Leaves colour wherever it giggles.

name: Cantor
look: A pearl-white singer robot with a small ring of tuning forks, mid-note.
quip: Hit the high note. The windows have not forgiven him.

name: Tempo
look: A watchmaker mage robot with a clockwork monocle and a small glowing hourglass.
quip: Punctual to the second. Sometimes the second before.

name: Helion
look: A young lion spirit with a short mane of warm sunlight.
quip: Mane of sunlight, ego to match. Roars at sunrise.

name: Marisol
look: A field-medic robot in a coral uniform with a med-kit and one tiny med-drone.
quip: Calm hands, tiny drone, zero patience for 'I'm fine'.

name: Vesnara
look: An obsidian sorceress android holding a small swirling ultraviolet void orb.
quip: Holds a tiny black hole. Keeps it on a very short leash.

name: Cosmo
look: A slender serpent dragon of teal starfield, gold constellation lines along its body, coiled in the air.
quip: Gold lines connect the stars. He still can't connect the dots.

name: Rosalind
look: A rose-gold lotus-armoured healer android opening its petal shoulders to release jade light.
quip: Opens up slowly, heals quickly, never mentions the thorns.

name: Omniarch
look: A towering platinum sorcerer android crowned by orbiting rune planets, magic storm around it.
quip: Rune planets orbit him. Him only.

name: Solenne
look: A colossal stag-dragon made of sunrise light striding over mountains, dawn sky trailing behind it.
quip: Brings the dawn personally. Zero sympathy for night owls.

name: Everheart
look: A vast floating crystal heart ringed by spinning halos, throwing full-spectrum light across a temple.
quip: A heart that big has to float. Gravity gave up.

name: Kensho
look: A samurai general android with twin hardlight katanas, cape whipping, a burning city behind him.
quip: Walked out of a burning city. Didn't look back or hurry.

name: Gorrath
look: A towering gladiator champion android in gunmetal and molten gold, roaring in a packed neon arena.
quip: The crowd chants his name. He has given them no choice.

name: Rimefang
look: A giant frosted-chrome wolf howling on a frozen peak, ice crystals on its back, breath of blue frost.
quip: Howls at the peak. The avalanche is just the echo.

name: Rexmortis
look: A black-chrome tyrannosaurus king with a crown of toxic-lime neon spikes, roaring over ruins.
quip: Short arms, long crown, and nobody dares mention either.

name: Terrakor
look: A mountain-sized titan mech carrying a glowing ringed planet on its shoulders, clouds at its knees.
quip: Carries a planet. Ask nicely before he moves.

name: Skyreign
look: A silver-white sky-fortress mech, half jet and half walking fortress, breaking through the clouds.
quip: Half jet, half fortress, entirely above your concerns.

name: Codexa
look: A giant spellbook golem, pages fanned into armour, violet runes storming around it in a vast library.
quip: Pages as armour, footnotes as weapons. Spoilers are free.

name: Chronelle
look: A time-sorceress android with floating clock-rune rings and a cracked hourglass heart, time shattering around her.
quip: Knows how this ends. The hourglass says hurry.

name: Starmother
look: A huge whale of living starlight swimming through a nebula, constellations across its body.
quip: Hums lullabies to galaxies. They go to bed on time.

name: Pyrazhar
look: A fire djinn of living flame and black smoke with a molten-gold mask, towering over a burning desert.
quip: Grants three wishes. All of them involve more smoke.

name: Halcyon
look: A six-winged porcelain angel healer descending in a beam of gold light through storm clouds.
quip: Six wings, one gentle sigh, a polite look of disappointment.

name: Sylvara
look: A world-tree healer construct of crystal and glowing vines with a leaf-canopy crown, a forest blooming around it.
quip: Planted one vine. The forest took it as an invitation.

name: Kaelis
look: A duelist android with three hardlight blades circling it, mid-spin.
quip: Three blades, no hands needed. The hands are for pointing.

name: Garrick
look: An armoured knight android braced behind a tall neon-glass tower shield.
quip: Hides behind a glass wall and still manages to look smug.

name: Glitchkin
look: An assassin android whose arm is dissolving into green code streams, ready to strike.
quip: Arm's in beta. Fists still ship on time.

name: Tressa
look: A violet-chrome three-headed serpent, each head hissing, faint glow in the jaws.
quip: Three heads, three opinions, one very unified bite.

name: Voltigre
look: A chrome tiger prowling, yellow lightning sparking along its claws.
quip: Purrs at ten thousand volts. Petting is at your own risk.

name: Dunestrike
look: A person-sized mechanical desert scorpion with an amber plasma stinger raised.
quip: Desert-built, sun-tested, unreasonably proud of the tail.

name: Arachnyx
look: An eight-legged spider-tank mech with red sensor eyes, legs braced.
quip: Eight legs, red eyes, and absolutely no personal space.

name: Haven
look: A floating fortress drone with a ring of glowing hex shields around it.
quip: Hex shields up. Opinions, however, remain fully exposed.

name: Ruckus
look: A heavy artillery walker with twin yellow-hot cannons, braced to fire.
quip: Subtlety was never in the manual. Neither was quiet.

name: Anvara
look: A blacksmith android hammering a molten orange rune on an anvil, sparks flying.
quip: Hammers spells into shape. Service comes with dents.

name: Orion
look: A star-mage android wrapped in a cloak full of galaxies, one hand glowing.
quip: Cloak holds a galaxy. Pockets still hold nothing.

name: Malvina
look: A witch android in a dark gown with three magenta hexes floating around one raised hand.
quip: Three hexes, one hand, zero patience for your excuses.

name: Kiyo
look: A nine-tailed fox of amber spirit light, tails fanned out.
quip: Nine tails, nine alibis, and one suspiciously clean paw.

name: Frostine
look: A bird of living ice crystals and pale blue light, wings raised.
quip: Cool under pressure. Crystalline, actually. Don't touch.

name: Thundercub
look: A lightning beast of yellow electricity with a small thundercloud mane, crackling.
quip: Tiny thundercloud, big voltage, strict nap schedule.

name: Lustre
look: A crystal-chandelier healer android pouring warm golden light from its hands.
quip: Chandelier by day, emergency lighting by night.

name: Gearwing
look: A clockwork medic beetle construct with glowing green repair arms working.
quip: Mends, tightens, oils. Won't stop until you shine.

name: Corallia
look: A reef healer android of pink coral with glowing sea-light in its chest.
quip: Grows slowly, glows warmly, bleaches when ignored.

name: Sable
look: A marksman robot with a red rail rifle slung over its shoulder and a scope eye.
quip: Never wastes a shot. Sometimes waits all day to prove it.

name: Knox
look: A boxer robot with orange piston gloves, guard up.
quip: Gloves run on hydraulics. Feelings do not.

name: Yume
look: A ninja robot in a violet scarf holding two glowing kunai.
quip: Silent as a whisper. The scarf, however, flaps loudly.

name: Aldric
look: A knight robot in clean pale-gold armour holding a halberd.
quip: Spotless halberd, zero tolerance for scuffs.

name: Zephyr
look: A sleek robo-falcon with small sky-blue jet vents, perched.
quip: Perched, polished, and just barely not gloating.

name: Goldtooth
look: A lean robo sabre-tooth cat with golden fangs, sitting proudly.
quip: Golden fangs, sitting pretty. The dental plan is excellent.

name: Octavia
look: A clever robo-octopus with hot-pink arms holding small tools.
quip: Eight arms, eight tools, no patience for flat-pack.

name: Brutus
look: A stocky bronze-plated robo-bulldog with a studded collar, loyal.
quip: Studded collar, bronze plating, unshakeable belief in fetch.

name: Digby
look: A mining robot with a yellow drill arm and a headlamp, ready to work.
quip: Headlamp on, drill ready, happily digs the whole shift.

name: Gale
look: A small copter robot with a pilot-face cockpit and green rotor lights.
quip: Hovers, judges, shoots. Rotor lights go green when smug.

name: Sarge
look: A little olive tank robot with a cannon and a sergeant cap, serious.
quip: Small tank, big cap, endless sermons about discipline.

name: Lazlo
look: A walking laser-turret robot with a violet lens eye, scanning.
quip: One lens, one idea, perfect aim. Scans before saying hello.

name: Brann
look: A craftsman robot in a leather apron carving a glowing orange rune with a chisel.
quip: Carves runes by hand. Spell-check not included.

name: Volta
look: A mage robot holding a short staff with a blue spark at the tip.
quip: Short staff, short fuse, forecast of static.

name: Nyra
look: A hooded shadow-mage robot with soft purple smoke at its feet.
quip: Hooded, hushed, and a little too fond of corners.

name: Fennick
look: An alchemist robot with goggles and a belt of glowing lime vials.
quip: Ninety percent sure that vial is safe. Stand back anyway.

name: Selene
look: An owl spirit of amber starlight with round moon eyes, perched.
quip: Stays up all night, judging your sleep schedule.

name: Mirra
look: A small glowing pink jellyfish spirit with a calm, dreamy face.
quip: Floats through life, wakes up for no one.

name: Nerin
look: A little water spirit riding a small curl of cyan wave.
quip: Rides a wave, makes more of them, apologises to none.

name: Ashka
look: A young wolf of glowing embers, a little ash drifting off it.
quip: Leaves a trail of ash and mild regret.

name: Hazel
look: A potion-brewer robot carrying a small bubbling green cauldron, stirring.
quip: Soup of the day: you, but better.

name: Gemma
look: A small crystal sprite with a glowing prism heart, kind smile.
quip: Sees every side of you and likes all of them.

name: Astra
look: A brass stargazer robot with a few small planets orbiting its head.
quip: Tracks every planet. Cannot track her keys.

name: Bramble
look: A small mossy stone golem with a few glowing ferns on its shoulders.
quip: Slow to anger, slower to move, fern collection thriving.
